thread:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in preemptible eviction jitter across eu-west1 GPUs. eviction rate up to 12% in the last 10m, variance looks elevated. /cc @ajay
ajay: saw the dashboard. is this aligned with the nightly training batch run? link: https://dash.internal/redwood/gpu-evictions?range=10m
maria: yes, batch window overlaps by ~6m. this is starting to eat SLO headroom for latency-sensitive routes — burn rate ~1.8x for route ml-infer-prod.
kelly: interesting — the mixed-pool autoscaler currently waits 5m of sustained signal before failing over. can we reduce that?
ajay: propose lowering fallback_delay to 90s when eviction_rate > 8% AND eviction_slope > 0.02/min. also add a jitter threshold to avoid flapping.
maria: agreed. also recommend a temporary bump in on-demand capacity for the canary pools while we tune.
ops-bot: ALERT: preemptible_eviction_jitter_high eu-west1 (12%) — Pager suppressed (escalation window 15m)
kelly: quick config patch suggestion for ml-infer pools — making spot_weight lower so autoscaler favors on-demand sooner. posting snippet: 
```yaml
pools:
  - name: ml-infer-eu-west1
    use_spot: true
    spot_weight: 0.4  # was 0.6
    fallback_pool: ml-on-demand-eu-west1
    fallback_delay_s: 90
    jitter_suppress_threshold: 0.05  # fraction of churn to ignore
```
ajay: +1. also add a derived metric `interruption_delta = eviction_rate - baseline_eviction_24h` so we alert on abnormal deviation rather than absolute only.
maria: good call. add an SLO-linked alert: if predicted_slo_burn_rate(route=ml-infer-prod) > 1.0 for 15m, fire high-priority pager.
kelly: I'll update the dashboard tiles: eviction_rate, interruption_delta, eviction_slope, predicted_slo_burn. will wire that into the alerting rule.
ajay: plan for rollout: patch autoscaler config in staging, run 30m canary targeting 10% of inference traffic, then promote. also pre-warm 2 on-demand instances to avoid startup penalty.
maria: +1. I'll coordinate the canary and monitor latency tails. if we see >200ms p95 delta, rollback.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled action: prewarm on-demand instances in ml-on-demand-eu-west1 (2 instances)
kelly: added interruption_delta to the eu-west1 dashboard and created alert prototype. linking runbook: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/preemptible-fallback
ajay: updated runbook with new `fallback_delay_s` recommendation and the CLI commands to scale on-demand quickly: `rctl pool scale ml-on-demand-eu-west1 --replicas 4` and `rctl pool set-weight ml-infer-eu-west1 --spot-weight 0.4`
maria: rolling the config now, will push change at 2065432300 and start the 30m canary after prewarm. monitoring window 2065432300-2065434100.
ajay: will watch logs and attach a short alert if canary sees >5% error or >1.5x latency burn.
maria: rolled at 2065432430. so far: eviction_rate down to 6.5% (early signal), p95 unchanged. keeping watch for 10m. :thumbsup:
kelly: thanks — follow-up items: add automated fallback test in the chaos suite to simulate eviction jitter, and include a regression test for chosen fallback_delay thresholds.
maria: filing tickets for chaos test + dashboard annotation. if anything degrades, we'll escalate to incident.
ajay: nice work team.
